title: Trump Congratulates Skverer Rebbe
body: President Donald Trump sent a congratulatory letter to the Skverer Rebbe for the wedding of his granddaughter in New Square's Skverer community, with blessings from the president and First Lady Melania Trump.

title: Rebbe's Historic Shabbos
body: Rebbe of Machnovka-Belz led a historic Shabbos in Yerushalayim's Old City, joined by supporters and builders of the Belz chassidus in Beit Shemesh. The gathering, "Mikdash Melech," united donors, community leaders, and families building the city's future.

title: Satmar Wedding Halls Expand
body: Satmar community in Williamsburg launches construction of two new state-of-the-art wedding halls as part of its "Express Wedding Project" to ease financial burden on young families.

title: Children at Risk of Losing Parent
body: Rav Aron Leib Shteinman's health is deteriorating, leaving 10 children orphaned. The children's mother passed away, and their father is now in critical condition. CLICK HERE TO HELP!
